esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| EVAL threshold_budget = 25000.0, threshold_pct = 80.0, alert_on_projected = true
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL
| INLINE STATS latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE @timestamp > latest_ts - 30 days
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR")),
       currency_symbol = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_currency_symbol)) > 0, TRIM(conf_currency_symbol), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"))
| EVAL units = COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * rate
| EVAL bill_day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, ts)
| EVAL active_dep = CASE(cost > 0 AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id != "" AND NOT STARTS_WITH(deployment_id, "deleted_or_unassociated") AND NOT STARTS_WITH(deployment_id, "unassociated") AND deployment_id != "organization", deployment_id, null)
| STATS
    spend = ROUND(SUM(cost), 2),
    units_total = ROUND(SUM(units), 2),
    billed_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(bill_day),
    active_deployments = COUNT_DISTINCT(active_dep),
    latest_day = LEFT(TO_STRING(MAX(ts)), 10),
    threshold = MAX(threshold_budget),
    warn_pct = MAX(threshold_pct),
    check_proj = MAX(alert_on_projected),
    sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "€"),
    unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "EUR")
| EVAL budget_used_pct = CASE(threshold > 0.0, ROUND(spend * 100.0 / threshold, 1), 0.0)
| EVAL daily_avg_spend = CASE(billed_days > 0, ROUND(spend / TO_DOUBLE(billed_days), 2), 0.0)
| EVAL projected_30d_spend = ROUND(daily_avg_spend * 30.0, 2)
| EVAL projected_pct = CASE(threshold > 0.0, ROUND(projected_30d_spend * 100.0 / threshold, 1), 0.0)
| WHERE budget_used_pct >= warn_pct OR (check_proj == true AND billed_days >= 3 AND projected_30d_spend > threshold)
| EVAL breach_reason = CASE(
    spend > threshold, "budget_exceeded",
    budget_used_pct >= warn_pct, "watermark_reached",
    "projected_30d_overrun"
  )
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", latest_day, "] Organization 30d spend of ", sym, TO_STRING(spend), " ", unit, " (", TO_STRING(budget_used_pct), "% of ", sym, TO_STRING(threshold), " ", unit, " budget; ", TO_STRING(units_total), " chargeable units across ", TO_STRING(active_deployments), " active deployments over ", TO_STRING(billed_days), "d; avg ", sym, TO_STRING(daily_avg_spend), "/day, projected 30d: ", sym, TO_STRING(projected_30d_spend), " ", unit, " / ", TO_STRING(projected_pct), "%) triggered ", breach_reason, " (watermark: ", TO_STRING(warn_pct), "%).")
| KEEP result, latest_day, breach_reason, billed_days, active_deployments, spend, budget_used_pct, daily_avg_spend, projected_30d_spend, projected_pct, units_total, threshold, warn_pct, unit
